title: World’s largest liquid-air storage facility comes online in China
summary:

title: October 2026 good for PV Production in Europe, but South of France and Ukraine missout
summary:
In a new weekly update for pv magazine, Solcast, a DNV company, reports that solar irradiance across much of Europe was around 10% above average in October 2026, reaching up to 25% above average in central Europe and the Baltic States due to persistent high-pressure systems.
However, southern France and the Black Sea region experienced below-average irradiance due to cloud cover and storms, while severe winds caused widespread power outages across western Europe.
